records.name: Flash Fist Crush
records.source_quest_or_shop: Shenron — I want a new Super Attack!
records.skill_description: A universal counter Strike Super that places the user in a defensive stance; if an attack connects during the counter window, the user throws a punch. The move can counter both Strike and Ki Blast attacks.
records.mechanics_notes: Short-range, single-hit universal counter. The user raises a hand in a defensive stance; a successful incoming attack triggers the punch. Unsupported frame-specific claims are not encoded.
records.acquisition_notes: Shenron's first I want a new Super Attack! result grants Flash Fist Crush. Historical sources consistently identify this as Hit's Super Attack and the Future Warrior's Shenron acquisition.
records.pve_notes: No Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Universal counter against both Strike and Ki Blast attacks; exact frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
